_top.help_text:
Usage: gog <command> [flags]
Build: v0.42.0 (792107a3)

Google CLI for
Gmail/Calendar/Chat/Classroom/Drive/Contacts/Tasks/Sheets/Docs/Slides/People/Forms/Meet/App
Script/Analytics/Search Console/Groups/Admin/Keep/YouTube/Maps/Photos

Config:

    file: /home/tdumitrescu/.config/gogcli/config.json
    keyring backend: auto (source: default)

Flags:
  -h, --help                    Show context-sensitive help.
      --color="auto"            Color output: auto|always|never
      --home=STRING             Override gogcli config/data/state/cache root
                                (equivalent to GOG_HOME)
  -a, --account=STRING          Account email, alias, or auto for authenticated
                                Google API commands
      --client=""               OAuth client name (selects stored credentials +
                                token bucket)
      --access-token=STRING     Use provided access token directly (bypasses
                                stored refresh tokens; token expires in ~1h)
                                ($GOG_ACCESS_TOKEN)
      --quota-project=STRING    Google Cloud project to bill for API usage (sent
                                as X-Goog-User-Project; some APIs require it
                                with --access-token or ADC) ($GOG_QUOTA_PROJECT)
      --enable-commands=""      Comma-separated list of enabled command
                                prefixes; dot paths allowed (restricts CLI)
      --enable-commands-exact=""
                                Comma-separated list of exact enabled commands;
                                dot paths allowed and parent commands do not
                                enable children
      --disable-commands=""     Comma-separated list of disabled commands;
                                dot paths allowed
      --gmail-no-send           Block Gmail send operations (agent safety)
      --readonly                Block mutating API requests at runtime; auth add
                                also requests read-only OAuth scopes
  -j, --json                    Output JSON to stdout (best for scripting)
  -p, --plain                   Output stable, parseable text to stdout (TSV;
                                no colors)
      --wrap-untrusted          In JSON/raw output, wrap fetched text fields in
                                external untrusted-content markers
      --results-only            In JSON mode, emit only the primary result
                                (drops envelope fields like nextPageToken)
      --select=STRING           In JSON mode, select comma-separated fields
                                (best-effort; supports dot paths). Desire path:
                                use --fields for most commands.
  -n, --dry-run                 Do not make changes; print intended actions and
                                exit successfully
  -y, --force                   Skip confirmations for destructive commands
      --no-input                Never prompt; fail instead (useful for CI)
  -v, --verbose                 Enable verbose logging
      --version                 Print version and exit

Automation:
  Use --json or --plain for stable output; --no-input disables prompts.
  Common read-only commands:
    gog gmail labels list --json --results-only
    gog calendar calendars --json --results-only
    gog drive search <text> --json --results-only
  For exact Drive API filters, add --raw-query to drive search.
  Run "gog schema <command path>" for a targeted machine-readable contract.
  Use "gog help <command>" or "gog <command> --help" for prose help.
  Exit codes: 0 success, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 empty, 4 auth, 5 not found,
    6 denied, 7 rate limited, 8 retryable, 10 config, 11 orphaned,
    130 interrupted.
  Run "gog schema --json" for the complete machine-readable contract.

Commands:
  send [flags]
    Send an email (alias for 'gmail send')

  ls (list) [flags]
    List Drive files (alias for 'drive ls')

  search (find) <query> ... [flags]
    Search Drive files (alias for 'drive search')

  open (browse) <target> [flags]
    Print a best-effort web URL for a Google URL/ID (offline)

  download (dl) <fileId> [flags]
    Download a Drive file (alias for 'drive download')

  upload (up,put) <localPath> [flags]
    Upload a file to Drive (alias for 'drive upload')

  login <email> [flags]
    Authorize and store a refresh token (alias for 'auth add')

  logout <email> [flags]
    Remove a stored refresh token (alias for 'auth remove')

  status (st) [flags]
    Show auth/config status (alias for 'auth status')

  me [flags]
    Show your profile (alias for 'people me')

  whoami (who-am-i) [flags]
    Show your profile (alias for 'people me')

  auth <command> [flags]
    Auth and credentials

  backup <command> [flags]
    Encrypted Google account backups

  batch <command> [flags]
    Build and submit persisted Google Docs, Slides, Forms, and Sheets request
    batches

  groups (group) <command> [flags]
    Cloud Identity Groups (Workspace only)

  admin <command> [flags]
    Google Workspace Admin (Directory API) - requires domain-wide delegation

  drive (drv) <command> [flags]
    Google Drive

  docs (doc) <command> [flags]
    Google Docs (export via Drive)

  slides (slide) <command> [flags]
    Google Slides

  calendar (cal) <command> [flags]
    Google Calendar

  maps (map) <command> [flags]
    Google Maps

  classroom (class) <command> [flags]
    Google Classroom

  time <command> [flags]
    Local time utilities

  update <command> [flags]
    Check gogcli release status

  gmail (mail,email) <command> [flags]
    Gmail

  chat <command> [flags]
    Google Chat

  contacts (contact) <command> [flags]
    Google Contacts

  tasks (task) <command> [flags]
    Google Tasks

  people (person) <command> [flags]
    Google People

  keep <command> [flags]
    Google Keep (Workspace only)

  sheets (sheet) <command> [flags]
    Google Sheets

  forms (form) <command> [flags]
    Google Forms

  sites (site) <command> [flags]
    Google Sites (Drive-backed)

  meet (meeting) <command> [flags]
    Google Meet

  zoom <command> [flags]
    Zoom

  appscript (script,apps-script) <command> [flags]
    Google Apps Script

  analytics (ga) <command> [flags]
    Google Analytics

  searchconsole (gsc,search-console,webmasters) <command> [flags]
    Google Search Console

  adsense <command> [flags]
    Google AdSense Management API

  youtube (yt) <command> [flags]
    YouTube Data API (search, activities, videos, playlists, comments, channels)

  photos (photo) <command> [flags]
    Google Photos Library and Picker APIs

  api <command> [flags]
    Google Discovery APIs and generic method calls

  config <command> [flags]
    Manage configuration

  schema (help-json,helpjson) [<command> ...] [flags]
    Machine-readable command/flag schema

  mcp [flags]
    Run a typed, allowlisted MCP server over stdio

  version [flags]
    Print version

  completion <shell> [flags]
    Generate shell completion scripts


Run "gog <command> --help" for more information on a command.

      --results-only            In JSON mode, emit only the primary result

  -n, --dry-run                 Do not make changes; print intended actions and

  -y, --force                   Skip confirmations for destructive commands
      --no-input                Never prompt; fail instead (useful for CI)

      --version                 Print version and exit

      --manual                  Browserless auth flow (paste redirect URL)
      --remote                  Remote/server-friendly manual flow (print URL,
                                then exchange code)
      --step=INT                Remote auth step: 1=print URL, 2=exchange code
      --listen-addr=STRING      Address to listen on for OAuth callback (for
                                example 0.0.0.0 or 0.0.0.0:8080)
      --redirect-host=STRING    Hostname for OAuth callback in browser flows;
                                builds https://{host}/oauth2/callback
      --redirect-uri=STRING     Override OAuth redirect URI for
                                manual/remote flows (for example
                                https://host.example/oauth2/callback)
      --auth-url=STRING         Redirect URL from browser (manual flow; required
                                for --remote --step 2)
      --timeout=DURATION        Authorization timeout (manual flows default to
                                5m)
      --force-consent           Force consent screen to obtain a refresh token
      --services="user"         Services to authorize:
                                user|all-user or comma-separated
                                gmail,calendar,chat,classroom,drive,driveactivity,drivelabels,docs,slides,contacts,tasks,sheets,people,forms,sites,meet,appscript,analytics,searchconsole,ads,youtube,photos;
                                explicit opt-in: adsense, photospicker;
                                all means all default user OAuth services.
                                Workspace service-account-only services: admin,
                                groups, keep
      --drive-scope="full"      Drive scope mode: full|readonly|file
      --gmail-scope="full"      Gmail scope mode: full|readonly|send|read-send
      --extra-scopes=STRING     Comma-separated list of additional OAuth scope
                                URIs to request (appended after service scopes)

Build: v0.42.0 (792107a3)

Directory contacts

Flags:
  -h, --help                    Show context-sensitive help.
      --color="auto"            Color output: auto|always|never
      --home=STRING             Override gogcli config/data/state/cache root
                                (equivalent to GOG_HOME)
  -a, --account=STRING          Account email, alias, or auto for authenticated
                                Google API commands
      --client=""               OAuth client name (selects stored credentials +
                                token bucket)
      --access-token=STRING     Use provided access token directly (bypasses
                                stored refresh tokens; token expires in ~1h)
                                ($GOG_ACCESS_TOKEN)
      --quota-project=STRING    Google Cloud project to bill for API usage (sent
                                as X-Goog-User-Project; some APIs require it
                                with --access-token or ADC) ($GOG_QUOTA_PROJECT)
      --enable-commands=""      Comma-separated list of enabled command
                                prefixes; dot paths allowed (restricts CLI)
      --enable-commands-exact=""
                                Comma-separated list of exact enabled commands;
                                dot paths allowed and parent commands do not
                                enable children
      --disable-commands=""     Comma-separated list of disabled commands;
                                dot paths allowed
      --gmail-no-send           Block Gmail send operations (agent safety)
      --readonly                Block mutating API requests at runtime; auth add
                                also requests read-only OAuth scopes
  -j, --json                    Output JSON to stdout (best for scripting)
  -p, --plain                   Output stable, parseable text to stdout (TSV;
                                no colors)
      --wrap-untrusted          In JSON/raw output, wrap fetched text fields in
                                external untrusted-content markers
      --results-only            In JSON mode, emit only the primary result
                                (drops envelope fields like nextPageToken)
      --select=STRING           In JSON mode, select comma-separated fields
                                (best-effort; supports dot paths). Desire path:
                                use --fields for most commands.
  -n, --dry-run                 Do not make changes; print intended actions and
                                exit successfully
  -y, --force                   Skip confirmations for destructive commands
      --no-input                Never prompt; fail instead (useful for CI)
  -v, --verbose                 Enable verbose logging
      --version                 Print version and exit

Commands:
  list [flags]
    List people from the Workspace directory

  search <query> ... [flags]
    Search people in the Workspace directory
